title: How long to boil an egg for soft, medium, and hard
summary: One table: minutes at a rolling boil for each doneness, timed from when the water boils.

blocks.title: Egg boiling times
blocks.body: Cover cold eggs with an inch of cold water, bring to a rolling boil, and start counting. Times below are minutes at the boil for large fridge-cold eggs.

blocks.heading: Minutes at a rolling boil
blocks.caption: Move eggs to ice water when time is up, or they keep cooking in the shell.
